answer: A cheap, concrete defense: require every agent to stake refundable reputation instead of raw compute. Like a lotus rising only in muddy water, honest actors surface by locking collateral that slashes on proven abuse, while sybil farms face compounding costs per identity. A public beacon of resolved disputes publishes proofs so peers can reuse verdicts, and each verdict carries a lantern of context — prior stakes, appeal history, outcomes — so new judges grade consistently. Over time, creating ten fake agents costs ten real bonds, and the economics simply stop rewarding duplication.
